title: Wanted to like them but...
text:
Wanted to like them but.... I'm redoing small touches throughout our home and throw pillows on the bed with a plain, salmon-colored coverlet makes sense. However, the design seems to be screened or painted on, and there were places where the design "bled." The colors were not as vibrant as pictured or in other reviews. Although I'm not a picky person, I wanted something that looks good from close and far. Returned.

The texture is close to burlap. It is not soft.

If you find this review helpful, please hit the button. Thank you. I received no compensation for this unbiased review.
